::: {.callout-tip}
## Correct the AI when it misreads your work

This page is the [logarithms page](logarithms-ai.qmd) with one addition. If the
AI misreads or misunderstands your uploaded work, choose **The AI misunderstood
my work** below its feedback. Point to the line or detail it missed, for example
“In line 2 the exponent is 2, not 3.” The AI checks your clarification against
the photo and gives one corrected reply, and the hints restart at level 1. Later
hints keep your clarification. To have changed or additional work assessed,
upload a new photo. The correction is available with direct API feedback, not
with “copy prompt”.
:::
